presets.name: Demo / local only
presets.description: Use deterministic local sample data; no external service calls.

presets.name: SaaS core plan
presets.description: A planned backend, identity, and billing integration; setup still required.

presets.name: AI-enabled app plan
presets.description: A planned server-side model API with local fallback data.

presets.name: Payment flow plan
presets.description: A planned checkout integration with no real transaction enabled.

integrations.name: Local demo data
integrations.meaning: Seed realistic but fictional data in the project; all actions stay in the browser and no records are submitted.

integrations.name: Browser LocalStorage
integrations.meaning: Persist small demo preferences or saved items in this browser only. No account sync, shared database, or server backup.

integrations.name: Supabase
integrations.meaning: Plan a Postgres backend and optional realtime data. Requires a project, schema, access policies, and server/client boundary review.

integrations.name: Clerk
integrations.meaning: Plan hosted user authentication and protected routes. Requires a configured application and redirect URLs.

integrations.name: Stripe
integrations.meaning: Plan hosted checkout and webhook verification. Never process payments from a static client; requires server-side setup.

integrations.name: OpenAI API
integrations.meaning: Plan model requests through a server route or trusted function. Do not expose API keys in browser code.

integrations.name: Google Gemini API
integrations.meaning: Plan model requests through a server route or trusted function. Do not expose API keys in browser code.

integrations.name: Resend
integrations.meaning: Plan transactional email behind a server endpoint; form actions remain local demos until configured.

integrations.name: PostHog
integrations.meaning: Plan privacy-conscious product analytics with consent and event boundaries documented.

integrations.name: Algolia
integrations.meaning: Plan hosted search indexing and client search. Keep admin keys server-side; use local filtering in demo mode.
